headline: Four Regions Show Fresh Base Changes
war_summary: Since the last edition, base counts have shifted in Mooring County, Weathered Expanse, Marban Hollow and Callum’s Cape. Mooring County now has 10 Warden bases and two Colonial, compared with 11 and one; Weathered Expanse has seven Warden-held bases and two neutral, after standing at six and three. Marban Hollow is now two Warden, three Colonial and three neutral, while Callum’s Cape shows six Warden bases and one neutral rather than one Colonial-held base. Callum’s Cape remains the busiest immediate ledger, with seven event rows in the latest two hours, chiefly at Naofa and Scouts Jest. Marban logged two rows in that span; Weathered Expanse, one. Nevish Line remains entirely Colonial-held, though three rows have appeared in its latest two hours. Linn Mercy logged 34 event rows over 24 hours, with one in the latest two. Several other previously active fronts have quieted: Callahan’s Passage remains wholly Warden-held, with no events in six hours. The war remains undecided; 34 victory towns are required.
